name: far-troll-goes-home-clear-route
description: D-174 (review): a full troll ~400 m from its hub on a known-dry, gentle route (stt.clearRoute picks it from world-generator heights) walks home across kept zones, reaches its ACTUAL hub, unloads, and every item is conserved. Isolates long-distance travel / zone transitions from terrain recovery.

steps.name: stt.arena
steps.label: start on the arena spot (MIGRATION_DECISIONS C26)

steps.name: stt.clearAround
steps.label: no tree, rock or stump around the spot the troll starts from (D-176: a stalled start in run 222441 had nothing else to blame)

steps.name: stt.clearMobs
steps.label: no wild creature to fight (fighting wins over unloading, D-149)

steps.name: stt.stepAside
steps.label: the player stands out of the troll's way and out of its hold range (D-176: TrollHold froze it with the player 2.4 m away)

steps.name: stt.hubFor
steps.label: the test hub still exists and is the troll's

steps.name: stt.hubDistanceInRange
steps.label: the troll starts about 400 m from its hub
within 45 s it is at least 30 m CLOSER to its hub (D-176: stt.moved counted any movement and its min was never enforced)

steps.name: stt.followedConserved
steps.label: every Stone put in is in the backpack or a depot - nothing lost or made

asserts.name: stt.followedBackpackAtMost
asserts.label: it reached its hub and unloaded everything
